profile_text.body:
OneTrust is a software company founded in 2016 and headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. Its site describes it as helping companies manage privacy, consent, and AI governance while automating compliance and reducing risk. The company markets the OneTrust AI-Ready Governance Platform, which it says connects privacy, data, AI, and technology risk in one continuous system, letting organizations define purpose, automate assessments, enforce controls, and monitor new risks across domains.

Its AI product is OneTrust AI Governance. The description of that product notes a privacy-first approach, data governance, and compliance automation, and calls it suited to organizations whose primary concern is privacy. OneTrust says the platform provides a continuous, real-time view of how data and AI are used, so issues can be addressed before they escalate. The site also carries an account from GOL Trust for Aviation, which describes connecting databases to OneTrust and holding seven billion IDs in its storage database.

OneTrust's law exposure is recorded in Georgia, with a count of 105. No lawsuits or MCP servers are listed for the company.
